summary: Auto-snap-on-publish + auto-snap toggle E2E verified. Backend: 28/28 pytest PASS (incl. POST /api/routing/snap returning 200 with >10 coords, 400 when <2 points, and demo walks having dense OSRM-snapped segments). Frontend WEB: (1) toggle-auto-snap is visible above publish-walk and CHECKED by default; clicking it toggles the check icon off then on. (2) Auto-snap ON publish flow — tapped 3 points on create-map, filled title 'Auto snap test' + duration 20, clicked publish-walk; observed POST /api/routing/snap 200 followed by POST /api/walks 200, navigated to /walk/{id}, verified via API that segments[0].coordinates.length = 264 (>>10) and distance_km = 5.18 (real snapped route); walk-detail-map rendered showing a curved polyline following streets. (3) Auto-snap OFF publish flow — after unchecking, tapped 3 points, published; ZERO /api/routing/snap calls fired, walk saved with exactly 3 raw coordinates and distance 2.75km straight-line. Both flows navigate correctly to /walk/{id}. Regression flows previously verified in iteration_4 remain intact. NOTE: tile visual — the fix aimed for CartoDB Positron (light_all) but the tiles now show 'API KEY REQUIRED' watermarks because basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all requires attribution/api-key params for production traffic; per the user's 'c'est bon' note this is best-effort and NOT a functional failure — the map is fully usable and the route polyline is clearly readable.

create.tsx:112 defensive check `if (data?.coordinates?.length)` before mapping — good, protects against empty OSRM responses.

server.py /api/routing/snap remains stable and returns 200 with dense coords in <3s during E2E.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-snap-on-publish is verified. When testing Create tab: (a) always scroll to top and tap the map BEFORE filling title/duration, otherwise the ScrollView scrolls the map out of view and mouse.click page-coords land on inputs; (b) inspect toggle-auto-snap's checked state by looking for 'check-bold' in innerHTML — a Check icon is only rendered when autoSnap===true; (c) subscribe to page.on('response') to assert whether /api/routing/snap was called (should be 0 when toggle OFF, exactly 1 when toggle ON with >=2 points).
rca_of_issue: Follow-up bug reproduction: previously a walk created via the Create tab without pressing 'Snap to path' would be persisted with only the raw tapped points and rendered as a straight-line polyline crossing buildings on the walk detail. RCA: publish() sent points as-is to POST /api/walks with no snapping. Fix in create.tsx:104-118: on publish, if autoSnap && points.length >= 2, POST to /api/routing/snap and replace finalPoints with the OSRM-returned coordinates before creating the walk; snap failures fall back silently to raw points. New Pressable testID='toggle-auto-snap' exposes the setting with a default of true. Verified: 3 taps in Paris produced a 264-point snapped route (5.18km) that follows streets, and with the toggle disabled the same 3 taps produced exactly 3 raw coords (straight 2.75km line), proving both branches behave as designed.
